card.name: Words leading into "same or any of"
card.fires_on: Small words right after a drug or group is named, where the text is about to say "the same", "any of" or "all of" something. Examples are "contains", "the" or "any" after "drugs containing" or "hypersensitivity to the product or".

modes.label: Same or similar ingredients
modes.description: The word "contains" or "the" after a drug combination, just before "same or similar active ingredients".
modes.example: combination drug containing elexacaftor, tezacaftor, and ivacaftor (ELX/TEZ/IVA), which<< contains>> the same or similar active ingredients as AL

modes.label: Any of the components
modes.description: "any" after "or" in contraindication lists, just before "of its components".
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Doxapram is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to the drug or<< any>> of the injection components.

modes.label: Relative clause on a named thing
modes.description: A verb or comma right after "which" or a place name in general prose, before a statement about the whole set.
modes.example: The study was funded by F. Hoffmann-La Roche, which<< employed>> all the authors except Dr. Schlagen

card.writes: It pushes toward Chinese and English words meaning "among them", "the majority" or "including", and away from words meaning "different".
card.plain: It fires where a sentence is about to refer to the same ingredients, any of the parts, or most of a group.
